decision.reason: [ev-f941fa338b6a] only says "The `CONNTRACK_LOCAL` option has been deprecated" under "Agent Options"; it never says the option is an environment variable, and the section context adds nothing more. The option could just as well be an agent CLI flag, a cilium-config ConfigMap key or a per-endpoint datapath option, so the env-var{CONNTRACK_LOCAL, set} exposure rests on a guess about identity. Missing: upstream text (e.g. agent config reference or the PR) naming where this option is set, so the matching predicate can be written.
